title: I Know How You Are Going to React: Using Machine Learning to Forecast Emotional Reactions Based on Group Interactions
content: This research evaluates a novel machine learning approach to forecast individual emotions before they occur. Previous research has focused on classification of individual emotions based on non-verbal expressions. The approach presented here is based on the assumption that every group develops an inherent lawfulness in their interaction, as communication theory suggests. It seeks to discern those communication patterns inherent to these interactions that precede emotional expressions. This comprises patterns that lead to joy as well as those leading to sadness. Experiments with the IEMOCAP dataset show a test accuracy of 73 to 95 percent in these forecasts depending how many different emotions were to be forecasted. The accuracy slowly drops in a near-linear fashion, the further the emotional events to be forecasted lie in the future. These initial findings give rise to the believe that this could be a path towards forecasting emotionally charged events in group meetings, such as conflicts, before they occur. Further research on different datasets needs to be done to confirm this hypothesis.
